## Repository and initial setup

Jennifer created the public repository `IEAP-Series04-Rstudio` and added Sarah and Alexis as collaborators. Her first commits set up the whole project **before** anyone started working on the questions: `README.md`, `LICENSE`, `.gitignore`, the RStudio project, the master document `IEAP-Series04-Rstudio.qmd`, the bibliography style (`styles/apa.csl`), the two data sets and one empty file per part of the report in `sections/`. Each section file initially contained the instructions of its question as a comment, so that everyone knew exactly what to write and where.

The `.gitignore` was written at this stage, as required, so that no local or temporary file could enter the history:

-   RStudio and R session files (`.Rproj.user/`, `.Rhistory`, `.RData`, `.Ruserdata`), which are specific to each computer;
-   system files (`.DS_Store`, `Thumbs.db`);
-   Quarto temporary files and caches (`.quarto/`, `*_cache/`) and LaTeX temporary files (`*.aux`, `*.log`, `*.toc`…), which are regenerated at every render.

## One file and one branch per part

The master document only contains the YAML header, the setup chunk and one `include` line per section. Each part of the report lives in its own file, and each file has a single owner:

| Section | File | Branch | Owner |
|:-----------------|:-----------------|:-----------------|:-----------------|
| Random noise and linear regression | `01_random_noise.qmd` | `01_random_noise` | Jennifer |
| Literature and hypotheses | `02_literature_and_hypotheses.qmd` | `02_literature_and_hypotheses` | Sarah |
| 3h10m recording | `03_recovery_3h10m.qmd` | `03_recovery_3h10m` | Sarah |
| 7.5-min recording | `04_recovery_7m30s.qmd` | `04_recovery_7m30s` | Alexis |
| Conclusions | `05_model_comparison.qmd` | `05_model_comparison` | Jennifer |
| Git workflow | `06_git_workflow.qmd` | `06_git_workflow` | Alexis |

: The branch names follow a single pattern, `<section number>_<topic>`, so each branch can be matched to its file and to its question at a glance. Because two people never edit the same file, the branches could be developed in parallel without merge conflicts. The only shared file, `references.bib`, was edited on a single branch (`02_literature_and_hypotheses`).

Since all sections are rendered in the same R session, two sections could overwrite each other's objects (for example two different `models` or `data` objects). To avoid this, each section prefixes its objects and chunk labels: `r7_` / `r7-` for the 7.5-min recording and `r3h_` / `r3h-` for the 3h10m recording.
